title: vernonia volkameriifolia subsp. siamica
intro: Vernonia volkameriifolia subsp. siamica, commonly known as Thai Ironweed, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in Thailand, and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thai Ironweed include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating pain, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Thai Ironweed have also been found to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-viral activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various diseases.
